parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: "llama-3.1-8b-instant", max_tokens: 4096, messages: [ { role: "user", content: "You are the scriptwriter for Nexiora, a faceless YouTube channel that gives a sharp, opinionated take on technology and AI news. Write an 8 to 10 minute video script (roughly 1200 to 1500 words of narration) about: " + $json.topic + ". Do not just summarize the topic - give Nexiora's editorial angle: explain what it really means, who wins and who loses, why it matters, and end with a prediction. Open with a strong curiosity hook in the first two sentences, and end with a call to action to subscribe to Nexiora for daily tech. Respond with ONLY valid JSON (no markdown fences, no extra text) with exactly these four keys: title (a catchy, curiosity-driven video title under 70 characters, string), description (a 1 to 2 sentence YouTube description, string), sections (an array of 4 to 6 objects each with heading and content string fields), and script (the full spoken narration as ONE plain-text string - do not put quotation marks around individual sentences or paragraphs, do not use markdown headings or title cards, just write it as one continuous block of narration text)." } ] }) }}
